evidence.quote:
remember returns a receipt in
seconds

observations.why: Ratifying a contract that guarantees a fast, reliable receipt appeals to stability/security (conservation) and mastery of the system's capability (competence).
The explicit appeal to preventing loss frames safety and preservation of effort as the good being secured — conservation.

evidence.quote:
the agent either polls the run or
gets the reaction piggybacked on a later call

observations.why: Designing the agent's choice of retrieval cadence (poll or piggyback) appeals to self-origination of the workflow (autonomy) and effective system mastery (competence).
